whatItIs: dwave-ocean-sdk is an open-source project in the annealing and ising category. It is maintained by dwavesystems and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Installer for D-Wave's Ocean tools

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches annealing and ising workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: Ocean SDK <https://docs.dwavequantum.com/en/latest/ocean/>_ is D-Wave's <https://www.dwavequantum.com/>_ suite of tools for solving hard problems with quantum computers. For more information, see the Ocean documentation's installation <https://docs.dwavequantum.com/en/latest/ocean/install.html>_ page.
whoItsFor: Developers interested in Ising-model formulations, annealing workflows, and D-Wave-style solver ecosystems.
whatYouCanBuild: See how annealing-oriented projects model optimization problems.
